blocks.html: Yield Management is a pricing strategy that adjusts prices dynamically based on demand, supply, timing, and market conditions to maximize revenue.

Yield management helps businesses optimize pricing in real time to capture the highest possible revenue from available inventory or capacity. It is widely used in industries such as airlines, hotels, travel, events, and eCommerce.

items.html: Changing rates by season or timing
Forecasting peak and low demand periods

blocks.html: Prices increase when demand is high and may decrease when demand slows.
An airline raises ticket prices as seats fill closer to the departure date and lowers fares during off-peak travel periods.
Yield Management is a dynamic pricing strategy used to maximize revenue based on demand and market conditions.
Unlock smarter pricing strategies. MarketJoy helps businesses improve revenue performance through data-driven yield management approaches.
